d:
Bihar ke mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi in dinon charcha men hai. 25 navanbar ko shivangi sinh ki shadi rishikesh kumar se honi hai. shadi ke lie anant sinh ke paitrik ganv nadvan men bhavy taiyariyan ki ja rahi hain.
Mehmanon ke lie karib 6 lakh gulab jamun, 4 lakh logon ke khane ka intjam, 150 se jyada vyanjan aur jaypur ke hava mahal ki thim par bhavy jaymala stej taiyar kiya ja raha hai. itna hi nahin, shadi men ghurdaur ke vijeta ko mahindra thar dene ki ghoshna bhi ki gaee hai.
Dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki khas taiyariyan aur shahi intjama.
